content: Onyx (formerly Danswer), open source enterprise search. 40+ connectors (Drive, Slack, Confluence, Salesforce, GitHub, Jira) with real-time sync that respects document-level ACLs from the source app. Every response grounded with inline citations for verification. Hybrid search plus a knowledge graph over uploaded files and connector docs. SSO (OIDC/SAML/OAuth2), RBAC with basic/curator/admin roles, encrypted credentials. Also agents, web search, MCP, deep research. Takeaway for a small team product: connectors are the enterprise moat and the roadmap sink; role gradation stops at three levels even at enterprise scale.
